rationale: The 5-minute ATR is $0.01, which is effectively equal to the bid-ask spread, making any intraday edge mechanically impossible to realize after transaction costs. Despite extraordinary relative volume (11.11x, driven almost entirely by a single 14.3M-share candle), price moved only a few cents — suggesting a large institutional rebalance or creation/redemption event rather than directional momentum. With no news, no measurable volatility, and insufficient room between any plausible entry and stop-loss to justify a position, there is no tradeable edge present.
